verification_level: FAST plus BATCH plus the affected RT-STORE differential probe. Eight files audited; no memory-safety defect and no ABI/layout regression found; two unsafe-contract corrections (an over-permissive NULL allowance) plus one stale module note in v3_skid.rs, documentation-only; no behavioural edit; no new unsafe operation and no new hidden obligation.
scope: Per-file contract audit of the head entries of REMAINING-AUDIT.txt: the OSSL_ATTRIBUTES_SYNTAX item group and its two i2r rows; the singleUse and sOAIdentifier ASN1_NULL rows; the subject-key-identifier helpers and row; the TLS_FEATURE item, i2v/v2i pair and row; the OSSL_USER_NOTICE_SYNTAX item group, print_notice and row; the UTF8 string pair and its one-row table; and the X509_ACERT/OSSL_ISSUER_SERIAL/OSSL_OBJECT_DIGEST_INFO setters.

defects.detail: s2i_ASN1_OCTET_STRING's # Safety section declared `str` as "NULL or NUL-terminated", but the body forwards it to OPENSSL_hexstr2buf, whose ossl_hexstr2buf_sep starts with strlen(str_). A caller obeying the declared contract could therefore pass NULL and reach undefined behaviour; the authority has the same unguarded `strlen` precondition, so the correct contract is non-NULL. Corrected to "a non-NULL NUL-terminated string"; no code change.

s2i_skey_id's # Safety section declared `str` as "NULL or NUL-terminated", but both prefix tests call strcmp(str_, ...) and the non-"hash" arm forwards to s2i_ASN1_OCTET_STRING. NULL is undefined behaviour, and the authority also calls strcmp without a NULL check. Corrected to a non-NULL NUL-terminated string; `ctx` remains NULL-or-live, which the body does guard. No code change.

The row's doc comment still said the s2i slot is None because s2i_skey_id was withheld, while the initialiser has carried Some(s2i_skey_id) since D472. Rewritten to state that every slot is the authority's. No code change.

src/x509/v3_skid.rs:204: the s2i_skey_id SAFETY contract narrowed the same way for `str`, because both prefix tests are strcmp; `ctx` stays NULL-or-live.
src/x509/v3_skid.rs:263: stale row note claiming the s2i slot was withheld/None corrected to describe the authority-faithful Some(s2i_skey_id).

retained_obligations: src/x509/v3_sda.rs: the exported OSSL_ATTRIBUTES_SYNTAX item group follows the ASN1_ITEM contract (NULL-or-writable slot, readable cursor and extent for d2i; NULL-or-live value and NULL-or-writable cursor for i2d; NULL-or-live value for free); `i2r` receives a live BIO and a NULL-or-live STACK_OF(X509_ATTRIBUTE) whose elements are live, each attribute's object is NULL-or-live and each counted value is live for the printer; the descriptor names the crate-owned static X509_ATTRIBUTE item.

src/x509/v3_single_use.rs: the four callbacks ignore their value/context arguments; i2r answers 1 without writing; r2i/s2i answer the ASN1_NULL_new sentinel; i2s answers one allocator-seam CRYPTO_strdup block transferred to the caller; the row's item is ASN1_NULL_it.

src/x509/v3_skid.rs: `i2s_ASN1_OCTET_STRING` requires a live ASN1_OCTET_STRING whose data is valid for length (the authority does not NULL-check it); `s2i_ASN1_OCTET_STRING` requires a non-NULL NUL-terminated string and takes ownership of OPENSSL_hexstr2buf's block on success, freeing the fresh string on failure; `ossl_x509_pubkey_hash` accepts NULL or a live X509_PUBKEY, borrows pk for pklen bytes, writes into a 64-byte EVP_MAX_MD_SIZE buffer, and frees the fetched EVP_MD and the string exactly once on every arm; `s2i_skey_id` requires a non-NULL NUL-terminated string and NULL-or-live X509V3_CTX whose subject_cert/subject_req are live when selectable; the row's i2s cast is the authority's two-pointer ABI-compatible cast.
src/x509/v3_soa_id.rs: identical shape to v3_single_use.rs; i2s transfers one CRYPTO_strdup block and the row's item is ASN1_NULL_it.

src/x509/v3_tlsf.rs: the exported TLS_FEATURE allocator pair follows the ASN1_ITEM contract over the crate-owned static integer template; the pop_free thunk receives NULL or a live ASN1_INTEGER; `i2v` receives live stacks; `v2i` receives a live STACK_OF(CONF_VALUE) whose elements are live and whose value-or-name is NUL-terminated, and every invalid-id/new/set/push arm frees the current integer and the partially built list exactly once.

src/x509/v3_usernotice.rs: the exported item group follows the ASN1_ITEM contract; `NoticeBuf` adopts exactly one i2s_ASN1_INTEGER block and releases it once through CRYPTO_free at the authority's failure (48) or success (51) coordinate; `print_notice` receives a live BIO and USERNOTICE whose noticeref, organization, noticenos elements and exptext satisfy the ASN1 item's non-NULL/length invariants; a NULL stack element follows the authority's `(null)` then NULL-i2s refusal.

src/x509/v3_utf8.rs: `i2s_ASN1_UTF8STRING` accepts NULL or a live ASN1_UTF8STRING with data valid for length (zero length is refused), uses checked_add for length+1, fills exactly length bytes plus the NUL, and transfers the OwnedBlock to the caller; `s2i_ASN1_UTF8STRING` accepts NULL or a NUL-terminated string, frees the fresh string on ASN1_STRING_set failure and returns it otherwise; the one-row table's two casts are the authority's ABI-compatible function-type casts.

src/x509/x509aset.rs: `replace_gentime` requires a writable ASN1_STRING slot and a live source, refuses a non-GENERALIZEDTIME type, no-ops on identity and replaces only after a successful duplicate; `replace_dirName` requires a writable GENERAL_NAMES slot and a live X509_NAME, builds name-copy/stack/name and hands the copy to GENERAL_NAME_set0_value, freeing each partial build once and releasing the caller-owned old stack only on success; the twelve exported setters require a live containing object and a live source (or a transferred value for set0_holder_*), and every copy/duplicate failure follows the authority's answer.

residuals: M87-R1 (info, authority behaviour preserved): s2i_ASN1_OCTET_STRING assigns `length as c_int`; a hex input over INT_MAX bytes would truncate. The authority assigns `long` to the int field with the same truncation, and ASN.1 parse/encode keeps lengths non-negative and bounded, so the arm is unreachable in practice and is not a newly introduced memory-safety obligation.

M87-R2 (info, authority behaviour preserved): i2s_ASN1_OCTET_STRING passes a negative `length` through to OPENSSL_buf2hexstr exactly as the authority does; a live ASN1_OCTET_STRING from the parser has a non-negative length.
secret_bearing_buffers: No secret-bearing buffer or cleansing claim changed. Every audited unit handles public certificate configuration, extension and attribute data; the only allocations are public strings, ASN.1 values and object stacks, released by the receiving item, extension machinery or NoticeBuf's single Drop.
